row1 cols1-3: 6,0,4
row2: 0,2,0
row3: 4,0,6
So center_block = [[6,0,4],[0,2,0],[4,0,6]]

Then corners = [(0,0),(0,-1),(-1,0),(-1,-1)] relative to output (3x3). cross = [(0,1),(1,0),(1,-1),(-1,1)].

For i=0: cross[0]=(0,1) = output[0,1] = output[0,0] = 6. Restore output[0,0] = input[0,0] = 7. So output[0,0]=7, output[0,1]=6.
i=1: cross[1]=(1,0) = output[1,0] = output[0,-1]=output[0,2]=4. Restore output[0,-1]=input[0,-1]=input[0,4]=5. So output[0,2]=5, output[1,0]=4.
i=2: cross[2]=(1,-1)=output[1,2]=output[-1,0]=output[2,0]=4. Restore output[-1,0]=input[-1,0]=input[4,0]=5. So output[2,0]=5, output[1,2]=4.
i=3: cross[3]=(-1,1)=output[2,1]=output[-1,-1]=output[2,2]=6. Restore output[2,2]=input[2,2]=input[4,4]=7. So output[2,2]=7, output[2,1]=6.

Wait check: output before modifications: [[6,0,4],[0,2,0],[4,0,6]].

After i=0: output[0,1]=output[0,0]=6 -> [[6,6,4],...]; then output[0,0]=input[0,0]=7 -> [[7,6,4],...].
After i=1: output[1,0]=output[0,2]=4 -> [[7,6,4],[4,2,0],[4,0,6]]; output[0,2]=input[0,4]=5 -> [[7,6,5],[4,2,0],[4,0,6]].
After i=2: output[1,2]=output[2,0]=4 -> [[7,6,5],[4,2,4],[4,0,6]]; output[2,0]=input[4,0]=5 -> [[7,6,5],[4,2,4],[5,0,6]].
After i=3: output[2,1]=output[2,2]=6 -> [[7,6,5],[4,2,4],[5,6,6]]; output[2,2]=input[4,4]=7 -> [[7,6,5],[4,2,4],[5,6,7]].

So verifier output: [[7,6,5],[4,2,4],[5,6,7]].

Compare to the natural language rule result: [[7,4,5],[4,2,4],[5,6,7]]. Row0 differs: rule says [7,4,5], verifier says [7,6,5].

Then output[corners[i]] = input global corner value.
